name: [🥭] Farm a Brainrot
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Farm a Brainrot!

How to Play:
🐎 Buy a Brainrot in the Shop
🌾 Place it in your base
💰 Generate money
🍉 Buy food to make your brainrot better
✋ Show off to your friends

💻 Supports, Desktop, Mobile
